text: At the Munich Security Conference, Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated U.S. and European interests are "intertwined" and affirmed support for NATO and existing institutions while urging reform and greater European defense and industrial capacity. European leaders emphasized strategic autonomy alongside preservation of the trans-Atlantic bond, amid ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and Gaza.

meta.note: Rhetorical reaffirmation coincides with prior U.S. criticism of European alliance.
